name: sample/pipeline — research → plan → act
description: A linear three-stage pipeline: read-only research feeds an optional context into the planner, the plan drives the executor. Shows per-node budgets and on_failure='skip': if the research node dies, the graph continues and the planner falls back to the goal alone (its only REQUIRED input), so a flaky lookup degrades instead of aborting the turn.

config.task: Read-only research: gather the context needed to accomplish the goal (web or local knowledge). Do NOT modify any files, memory, or anything outside this task.
Execute the plan and deliver the final answer to the goal.
